text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers in Moss's notes:

1. **#PD-4492**, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md). Thea Ramaswell opened it on 4 Oct 2025. Drivers at Dock Doors 14–18 in the Eau Claire yard weren't getting SMS bay assignments. Support patched it that evening, and Thea confirmed on 5 Oct that the next 04:00 shift checked in without problems.
2. **#4419**, from "Moss: North cheat sheet" (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md). This note has no date. Thea logged it because the gatehouse barcode scanners couldn't read trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. It was escalated to tier-2 support to test the scanner firmware.

Moss's other North and Central digests mention QFL but give no ticket numbers. Moss hasn't posted in #general or #help-it-ops. I didn't include Marcus's note on "Quarendon Freightways" (one R) because it's a different company and not a customer.

One thing to watch: because the cheat sheet has no date, I can't tell whether #4419 is still open or if it came before or after #PD-4492.
